title: elytrigia repens subsp. koeleri
intro: Elytrigia repens subsp. koeleri, commonly known as Koeleri's couch grass or Elymus koeleroi, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Elytrigia repens subsp. koeleri include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and lower blood sugar levels. Its therapeutic actions include antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids.
